steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Nuclear weapons can destroy entire cities and kill millions. Their existence raises serious moral questions for religious believers about whether they can ever be justified. | RS Exam Tips — Nuclear Weapons and Pacifism: 1. For Nuclear Weapons and Pacifism questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of Nuclear Weapons and Pacifism to its real-world impact on believers and society | UK Context: In the UK, debates about often involve both religious and secular voices.
